title: Provider JMAP Chat subset
description: Provider-side base JMAP Chat subset needed by the urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:mimi capability, per the approved .12 plan (mimid-1wgh.12 design field) and decision JM-4 (mimid-1wgh.12.22). Spec target: jmap-chat-spec cefc217 (identity model: local ChatContact.id, identity, owner = accountId). crate-jmap pin: b8b6f251. The provider never decrypts; Message bodies are application/mimi-fanout. Landed: .11.1 auth (c0fff18), .11.2 HTTP surface/Session/dispatch (ab91235), .11.3 read projection (9007853). Open: .11.6 EventSource. Decisions: .11.4 (notJSON for deep JSON), .11.5 (per-account maxConcurrentRequests), .11.7 (deliveryState delivered), .11.8 (whole-call invalidArguments), .11.9 (empty name after leaving).
notes: Per mimid-1wgh.30: build on ~/PROJECT/crate-jmap jmap-chat-server + jmap-chat-types. First: check their conformance to current draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 and whether E2EE mode is supported.
